label: Full-Stack Software Engineering
description: I build scalable backend services, secure REST and WebSocket APIs, and database architectures using Node.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. From user authentication to background jobs and caching with Redis, I deliver dependable systems ready for production traffic.

label: Frontend & Web Application Development
description: I build responsive, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I emphasize modular component structure, accessible UI design, and Core Web Vitals optimization to ensure rapid page load times across mobile and desktop devices.

label: Maintenance & Performance Optimization
description: I keep live web platforms secure, up to date, and fast. This includes routine dependency upgrades, database backups, security patches, uptime monitoring, and proactive bug fixing before issues affect users.
